_comment: Signature vectors for SPEC section 7. Each names a signed lease fixture, the fixture it was DECLARED from, and the key file.
An adapter offering hash(value) and verify(lease, keyHex) is checked: hash(declared) equals lease.declared_hash, verify(lease, key) is true,
and verify of the lease with one signature byte changed is false. The key is a published TEST key; a verifier MUST refuse it outside a conformance run.
The reference algorithm is HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical bytes of every lease field except signature, lower-case hex.

vectors.name: minimal-declared-but-must-be-refused-at-issue
vectors.why: Validates and verifies; an issuer MUST still refuse it (R2, R4). Conformance has three halves.
